task.text:
[0] A missense mutation in clk-1 extended the lifespan of C. elegans.

[1] A missense mutation in clk-1 extended the lifespan of C. elegans.

[2] A missense mutation of clk-1 extended the lifespan of C. elegans.

[3] The null mutation of clk-1 extended the lifespan of C. elegans.

[4] The null mutation of clk-1 extended the lifespan of C. elegans.

[5] The null mutation of clk-1 extended the lifespan of C. elegans.

[6] The null mutation of clk-1 extended the lifespan of C. elegans.

[7] Missense mutation of clk-1 (COQ7) extended the lifespan of worms. Bacterial dilution for feeding was supplemented with FUDR, IPTG, and ampicillin.

[8] cbp-1 (CREBBP) knockdown decreased the life-extending effect of clk-1 (COQ7) mutation in worms. Age was counted from stage L4. Bacterial dilution for feeding was supplemented with FUDR, IPTG, and ampicillin.

[9] Once hatched worms reached L4 larval stage, animals were transferred onto plates containing 50 µM 5-fluorodeoxyuridine (FUdR).

Each numbered passage describes one lifespan experiment. For each, report three things using ONLY that passage:
  organism: the model organism studied, one lowercase word
  direction: exactly one of 'increases lifespan', 'decreases lifespan', or 'no change'
  method: how the gene was altered, e.g. gene knockout, overexpression, mutation, knockdown

Output one block per passage, in order, formatted exactly:
[0]
organism: ...
direction: ...
method: ...

Nothing else. If a passage does not state something, write 'unstated'.
